findings.title: Israel closes Rafah crossing to travelers, aid, commercial trucks
findings.affected_population_system: Travelers seeking passage between Gaza and Egypt; humanitarian aid and commercial truck entry from Egypt (food, fuel, gas and other goods); Kerem Shalom crossing reportedly unaffected.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Israeli authorities on Tuesday turned back travelers seeking to cross the Rafah border crossing and halted the entry of humanitarian aid and commercial trucks

bounded_discovery_context.checks: Xinhua wire report syndicated by Himalaya Times and reproduced in Detik (Nov 4) and Insight International (Nov 4); those are not independent wire confirmations. The report cites Gaza border crossings authority and Israeli military sources to Kan. Direct primary statements and precise publication hour were not located.
bounded_discovery_context.details: According to Xinhua, the Gaza crossings authority said Israel informed Egypt of suspension and approximately 40 aid/commercial trucks a day had been entering from Egypt. Israeli military sources cited alleged smuggling and Hamas security involvement; reasons are disputed/not independently verified. Report concerned Nov 3 event, published Nov 4; not proof closure continued uninterrupted at observation time.
